alt.en: A large screen showing an abstract network graph with an indigo trim stands at the center. Dashed orange lines with packets run into it from a gray server on the left and another on the right, and a dotted dark line joins it to a sheet marked with a padlock lying in front.
alt.zh: 画面中央立着一块带靛蓝边框的大屏幕，显示抽象的网络图。左右两台灰色服务器各有一条带数据包的橙色虚线连向屏幕，前方平放的一张印有挂锁图案的纸页以深色点线与屏幕相连。

caption.en: Illustration: configuration from two servers, standing for production and development segments, feeds a network map on a screen that is compared with a policy sheet, as in the method Amazon describes. It does not depict AWS Cloud WAN, Tiros or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：代表生产分段和开发分段的两台服务器把配置送入屏幕上的网络图，再与一张策略纸页比对，对应 Amazon 所描述的方法。图中并非 AWS Cloud WAN、Tiros 或任何经过测试的部署，也不表明这些检查确实如所述般有效。
